brief:
Israel's elections committee approved final election results after confirming the integrity of the voting process, the Ma'an news agency reported. The committee's certification followed a review of the electoral procedures and safeguards implemented during the balloting.

The decision came as the final step in formalizing the outcome of the election, with the committee satisfied that no irregularities had compromised the vote's legitimacy.
title: Israeli elections committee certifies results, confirms integrity
